heading: INT. MASCOT DRESSING ROOM, MINOR-LEAGUE BALLPARK - DAY

units.text: INT. MASCOT DRESSING ROOM, MINOR-LEAGUE BALLPARK - DAY
A cramped cinderblock closet crowded with giant heads: a hot dog, a gopher, a foam eagle with a bent beak.
It smells of old sweat and glue.
ZEPHYR OKONJO, twenties, half-dressed as the gopher, struggles with a zipper.
MORGANA TREVINO, fifties, the mascot coordinator, clutches a clipboard.
DUNCAN, nineteen, the hot dog, stands frozen with one arm in a sleeve.
Showtime in four minutes!
units.name: MORGANA

units.text: My zipper's stuck!
units.name: ZEPHYR

units.text: I can't see out of this thing!
units.name: DUNCAN

units.text: You don't need to see, Duncan, you need to wave.
units.name: MORGANA

units.text: Zephyr yanks.
Duncan staggers.
Both of them knock into Morgana, who drops the clipboard.
All three go down in a heap of foam and fur, the gopher head rolling away, the hot dog bun flapping.
Get off my tail!
units.name: ZEPHYR

units.text: That's my mustard!
units.name: DUNCAN

units.text: Both of you, stand up!
units.name: MORGANA

units.text: They stand, tangled.
A voice booms through the wall.
Ladies and gentlemen, please welcome your Oakwood Gophers!
units.name: ANNOUNCER

units.text: The three look at each other.
Zephyr picks up the gopher head, jams it on backwards, and runs for the door.
